name: Trips - Right - 30 Smash

QB.rule: Open right, hand to the tailback, then fake the boot left. It holds the backside end.

TB.rule: Take the handoff downhill between the center and the right guard. Do not bounce it.

coaching_points: There is no fullback iso. The tailback is the runner, downhill in the A-gap.
The slot and the split end both screen the perimeter. If the tailback bounces, the play is dead.
